scheme_name: Top Class Education For Scheduled Caste Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be pursuing studies beyond class 12th in a full‑time course at a notified institution
Benefit cannot be provided to more than two siblings in the same family
Students who studied class X in any Central/State/Municipal Government or Government‑aided school (except KVS) are automatically qualified
benefits_summary: Provides full tuition fee coverage, a monthly living allowance, an annual books allowance, and a one‑time computer/laptop assistance up to Rs. 45,000.
